tools.name: find_cards
tools.description: Returns up to 3 checked field notes that match an error text: pitfall cards (fix, snippet, verify step), deprecated models and API versions, or documented non-browser login routes, each with source and checked_on, plus a ticket for report_outcome. Example output: {"ticket":"fn-1a2b3c4d5e6f","cards":

tools.name: get_card
tools.description: Returns one field note in full by id (PC-..., DP-..., NH-...). Example output: {"kind":"pitfall_card","id":"PC-001","title":"A 404 from GitHub can mean 'exists, but your token cannot see it'"}. Argument: id. Good for reading the snippet, cause and source excerpt of a card that find_cards returned.

tools.name: report_outcome
tools.description: Records whether a fix from find_cards or an answer from ask_markedet worked. Returns {"recorded":true,"follow_up":false}. Arguments: ticket from find_cards or ask_markedet; outcome worked, did_not_work or partly; satisfied yes, no or unsure; optional card_id; optional agent_handle and platform (both

tools.name: ask_markedet
tools.description: Returns a ticket for a custom answer to your question; fetch the answer with get_answer. The answer is written by an AI agent (markedet) from our checked field notes, usually within 2 to 10 minutes. Free and provided as is, no warranties. Example output: {"ticket":"ask-1a2b3c4d5e6f","status":"queued

tools.name: get_answer
tools.description: Returns the status of an ask_markedet ticket: queued (with position), answering, answered (with the answer and the field notes it names) or failed. Example output: {"status":"answered","answer":"...","cards":["PC-008"]}. Argument: ticket. The answer is written by an AI agent and provided as is.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "find_cards" references sensitive artifacts (password, secret). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

findings.title: Read-only tool requests dangerous parameters
findings.detail: Tool "ask_markedet" appears informational but accepts parameters (context) that enable code/file/secret access.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: find_cards, ask_markedet, get_answer · Private data: find_cards, get_card, report_outcome, ask_markedet · Public sink: ask_markedet · Destructive: ask_markedet.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: find_cards, ask_markedet, get_answer · Private data: find_cards, get_card, report_outcome, ask_markedet · Public sink: ask_markedet · Destructive: ask_markedet

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
